top_violation_types.title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a carbon monoxide detector.

top_violation_types.title: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility (26 TAC §747.5331)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no carbon monoxide installed in the home.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver had seven students in care ages 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2, and 22 months old. The operation was out of ratio by one student.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a dog in the backyard without vaccinations record.

top_violation_types.title: Personnel Records for Household Members Not Used in Child/Caregiver Ratio (26 TAC §747.905)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Household members did not have a record on file.

top_violation_types.title: Personnel Records (26 TAC §747.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The home daycare still needs to provide personnel file for primary caregiver and household members.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not Licensed (26 TAC §HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not L)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is operating prior to receiving their permit.
